title: Reverse Integer
summary: Reverse the decimal digits of an int, keeping its sign, and return 0 when the result does not fit in an int.
followUps: Can you do it with int arithmetic only, never holding a value outside the int range?
How would you tell whether an int reads the same with its digits reversed, without any risk of overflow?
How would you reverse a long the same way, when there is no wider type to check against?
